title: MR-Ben: A Meta-Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating System-2 Thinking in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative error analysis of sampled failure cases to determine the proportion of Type I errors (overlooking mistakes and mislabeling them as correct) made by the LLM acting as an evaluator.
Qualitative observation of the model's inherent tendency to follow prompt inputs, which artificially skews its labeling threshold toward positive judgments when evaluating Chain-of-Thought steps.
Theoretical and qualitative discussion of the phenomenon where an LLM evaluator inherently favors its own generated output over texts from other models or humans during self-evaluation methods.
Quantitative assessment computing Pearson Correlation Coefficients between the length of solutions and their correctness across different disciplines to identify dataset artifacts.
